'''2016 Match Play Championship''' was the Players Committee match-play championship, 8–10 January 2016. [[Tom Kelly]] finished 1st in Day 2.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2016-match-play-championship/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' United States
* '''Dates:''' 8–10 January 2016
* '''Winner:''' [[Tom Kelly]]
